subject: general
question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the smallest area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan**__.

__
 
• **Bhutan**__ has the smallest area among neighboring countries of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A total of **9 countries share borders with India**.
 
• Out of these,** 7 countries **share** land borders **while** 2 countries **share **sea borders** with India.
 
• **Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, Myanmar, Nepal, and Pakistan** share land borders with India.
 
• **Sri Lanka** and the **Maldives **are two countries with water borders.
 
• **Bhutan **is the** smallest neighboring country of India **in terms of area and land borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The total area of **Bhutan **is **38,394 km².**
 
• The total area of **Myanmar **is **676,575 km²**.
 
• The total area of **Nepal **is **147,516 km²**.
 
• The total area of **Pakistan **is **796,095**** km²**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba97ae79b284d96ace87d6e9150ea6b66768e69ed308d9bae560eaffc2a2018b.png]
